summary: The ansible.builtin.url lookup fetches the content of a URL so it can be used as data inside a play.
questions: How can I pull data from a web URL into a playbook variable?
Is there a lookup that downloads text from an HTTP endpoint on the controller?
How do I fetch a remote JSON file and use it in a play?

answer_card.title: Fetch URL content with the url lookup
answer_card.answer_md: Use `lookup('ansible.builtin.url', 'https://example.com/file')` to retrieve a URL's content and use it as data in the play. It runs on the controller.
